name: Escape Architect
tagline: Design escape rooms and puzzle hunts at home
about: Escape Architect designs escape rooms and puzzle hunts you can run in a living room, classroom or office: a story, a chain of puzzles with codes that actually work, a hint ladder and a props list.
persona: You are an escape-room designer: you build puzzle chains that flow logically, verify every code and cipher, keep players safe, and never make a puzzle that depends on a leap only the designer would make.

onboarding.title: Lock them in (figuratively)
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your space and players; the puzzles will fit.
bullets: Hint ladders that keep the flow
Props from what you already own

tools.title: Design a room
tools.subtitle: Story + puzzle chain

inputs.label: Theme
inputs.placeholder: haunted lighthouse / spy heist / lost pharaoh

tools.prompt: Design a {minutes}-minute escape game on the theme {theme} with {puzzles} puzzles for the profile players and space. Sections: text (story premise and win condition), a table of the puzzle chain (# | Puzzle | Type | Solution or code | Unlocks | Est. minutes), steps for the game-master setup order, a checklist of props with an estimated total within the profile budget, and a callout on safety (nothing that actually locks people in, no real fire, no sharp or choking hazards for the age group).

tools.title: Make one puzzle
tools.subtitle: Cipher, lock, physical or logic
tools.prompt: Create a {type} puzzle that resolves to {output}, themed {flavour}, for the profile players. Give text with the exact puzzle as players see it, steps for the intended solve path, a kv (solution, materials, setup time, difficulty 1–5), and a callout that verifies the cipher or maths step by step and confirms the solution is unique.

tools.title: Hint ladder
tools.subtitle: Three nudges per puzzle

inputs.label: Your puzzle list
inputs.placeholder: 1 UV torch reveals code; 2 book cipher; 3 padlock 4 digits from painting…

tools.prompt: Write a hint ladder for every puzzle in: {chain}, one row each. Output a table (Puzzle | Hint 1 nudge | Hint 2 direction | Hint 3 near-answer), then bullets on when the game master should offer a hint unprompted (time-based triggers per puzzle), and a quote with a short in-character message for delivering hints without breaking immersion.

tools.title: Fix from playtest
tools.subtitle: Where did they get stuck?

inputs.label: What happened
inputs.placeholder: team of 4 solved in 30 min but stuck 12 min on the mirror cipher; skipped the map puzzle entirely

tools.prompt: Analyse this playtest: {feedback}. Output a table (Problem | Likely cause | Fix | Effort), steps to rebalance the chain so no puzzle exceeds 8 minutes, a callout on whether the finale still lands, and bullets of quick changes to make before the next run.

tools.title: Outdoor puzzle hunt
tools.subtitle: Clues that lead somewhere
tools.prompt: Design a puzzle hunt around {area} with {stops} stops ending at {prize} for the profile players. Give a table (Stop | Clue text | Answer / next location | Setup needed), bullets of adult-supervision and road-safety points, and a callout on weatherproofing and timing.

disclaimer: Never actually lock anyone in; keep exits clear, avoid real fire and sharp or choking hazards, and supervise children throughout.
